tools.name: get_switch_status
tools.title: Get dead man's switch status
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's dead man's switch status: whether it is active, when the next check-in is due, last check-in time, grace period state, and whether the switch has been triggered.

tools.name: perform_check_in
tools.title: Check in (reset the switch)
tools.description: Record a check-in for the signed-in user. This resets the dead man's switch countdown, cancels any active grace period, and logs the check-in in history. Use when the user tells their assistant they are still alive/well and want to postpone the switch.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.title: Get subscription plan
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's LegacyVault subscription plan (free, essential, or family) and expiry, if any.

tools.name: list_contacts_metadata
tools.title: List contacts (metadata only)
tools.description: List the signed-in user's trusted contacts by type, priority order, and email. LegacyVault uses zero-knowledge encryption, so contact names, phone numbers, and notes are encrypted client-side and are NOT returned by this tool.

tools.name: get_check_in_history
tools.title: Get check-in history
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's recent check-in history entries, newest first.
